title: dedicated-autoscaler-burst-controls-util-reporting-v41
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Improvements to Dedicated autoscaler: added burst token controls, throughput guarantees per-fleet, and enhanced utilization reporting metrics. Backwards-compatible config; migration instructions included.
description: Context: Customers running Dedicated fleets reported tail latency spikes and unpredictable token consumption during short high-concurrency bursts. This PR implements a combined token-bucket burst controller with smoother decay and per-fleet throughput guarantees, and adds richer utilization reporting to help SREs tune autoscaling policies. Motivation: reduce failed requests during transient spikes, improve capacity planning visibility, and provide explicit throughput guarantees for reserved capacity. Summary of changes: 1) autoscaler/core: introduce BurstTokenBucketController with configurable burst_capacity, refill_rate, and smoothing_window_ms; 2) autoscaler/scheduler: add throughput_guarantee enforcement path that reserves a minimum token budget per-fleet and preallocates queued slots under contention; 3) reporting: emit new metrics redwood.dedicated.fleet.utilization.avg_window, redwood.dedicated.fleet.burst.tokens, redwood.dedicated.fleet.throughput.guaranteed; 4) API: add optional policy fields in DedicatedFleetSpec: burstControls and throughputGuarantee with validation and defaulting; 5) observability: console dashboards and alerts wiring for the new metrics; 6) tests: unit tests for token bucket edge cases and e2e integration test in perf-canary. Checklist: - [x] Design doc updated (Linear ENG-4821) - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration perf tests added and run - [x] Migration & validation logic included - [x] Docs/console wiring included Commits summary: 2 commits. Commit 1: core token-bucket implementation and unit tests. Commit 2: API surface + reporting + dashboard wiring and integration test. Files changed: autoscaler/token_bucket.go autoscaler/scheduler.go api/dedicated_fleet.proto api/validation.go observability/dashboards/dedicated_burst.json observability/metrics/registry.go perf-canary/scenarios/burst_load.yaml docs/running-dedicated/autoscaler.md test/autoscaler/tokenbucket_test.go test/integration/dedicated_burst_integration_test.go Review conversation: Diego Morales (reviewer) requested tighter validation on throughputGuarantee fields and suggested moving smoothing_window_ms to milliseconds for clarity; author replied that validation and unit conversion were added and included an explanatory comment; Ravi Shah asked for additional logging around token reclaims which was added with a debug flag; Lena Chen triggered perf canary which showed 18% reduction in tail 95 latency and 3.2% increase in steady-state GPU utilization at 99th percentile p99 concurrency, author annotated results in the PR. CI: initial run failed on a lint rule for proto ordering, author rebased and fixed ordering, rerun CI passed. Backwards compatibility: configuration defaults preserve previous behavior when burstControls is unset; throughputGuarantee is opt-in. Migration: small migration step included in api/validation.go that rejects invalid legacy fields and emits a warning in control plane logs. Testing & perf: perf-canary scenarios show burst smoothing prevents token starvation during 60s spike windows while keeping autoscaler scale-down behavior unchanged for normal workloads. Observability: new metrics are exported via observability/metrics and surfaced in Console under Dedicated->Fleet->Utilization; included Grafana panel JSON sample. Rollout plan: staged rollout pinned behind feature flag dedicated.autoscaler.v41, enable for 10% of fleets for 48 hours, evaluate metrics and WARN on increased preemptions. Merge outcome: merged via squash after approvals from reviewers and green CI. Related: references Linear ENG-4821 and support ticket SUP-3210. Notes: kept changes minimal in scheduler hot paths and microbenchmarked token checks to ensure <200ns median overhead per request on a p4d-8xlarge equivalent.

discussion_summary: Reviewed validation and logging changes; perf-canary showed improved tail latency and slight increase in utilization. Fixed proto lint; added migration warnings.
notes: Feature gated behind dedicated.autoscaler.v41; staged 10% rollout for 48h; monitor redwood.dedicated.fleet.preemptions and redwood.dedicated.fleet.burst.tokens.
